column1: Knowledge

The demo as-of date is 2026-09-30 which is the last day of Q3 2026. Any question about today or this quarter refers to that date and to Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30). The quarter close starts on 2026-10-01.

Meridian Clinician Network is a free professional network for US physicians nurse practitioners physician assistants and pharmacists. Revenue is B2B: pharma brands buy specialty-targeted campaigns and sponsored content and health systems buy recruiting placements and employer branding.

Every closed deal exists in three systems that should agree: the signed agreement in DocuSign (the legal truth whose extracted terms are in CONTRACTS CONTRACT_LINE_ITEMS and CONTRACT_BILLING_SCHEDULE) the closed-won opportunity in Salesforce entered by the rep and the NetSuite sales order created by Boomi which drives billing and revenue recognition.

An agreement or contract chain is one original signed document plus all of its amendments. The chain is identified by the original contract number (for example MCN-2025-0142); amendment documents append a suffix (MCN-2025-0142-A2). V_CONTRACT_CHAIN has one row per chain with the current terms taken from the latest signed document.

An amendment row in CONTRACTS restates the whole agreement after the amendment (total contract value end date payment terms billing frequency and the full exhibits) so the latest document of a chain is always the current truth. In Salesforce an amendment is its own opportunity booked for the increment so the Salesforce value of a chain is the sum of its opportunities.

There is no precomputed reconciliation results table. The eleven three-way checks are derived live from the raw tables and the helper views; RECONCILIATION_CONTROLS is the rulebook that gives each check its tolerance severity rule owning team and SOX control reference. Until this demo the reconciliation was manual work in Alteryx spread across Sales Ops Revenue Accounting and Billing.

The three-way match at the 2026-09-30 close finds about 52 of 270 agreements (roughly 19 percent) failing at least one check with about 31 million dollars of exposure and about 90 High severity findings. Missing billing milestones carry most of the exposure dollars.

Halvorsen Therapeutics (CUST-0017 account owner Dana Whitfield) is the agreement to open first. Chain MCN-2025-0142: the master agreement signed 2025-02-10 for 1.8 million dollars then Amendment 1 (2025-06-16 adds Sponsored Content to 2.25 million) Amendment 2 (2025-11-03 extends the term to 2027-02-28 to 2.85 million and converts billing to milestones) and Amendment 3 (2026-07-20 reduces the campaign unit price to 2.73 million and changes payment terms to Net 45).

For Halvorsen Therapeutics Salesforce reflects Amendment 2 only (2.85 million booked so Amendment 3 is missing) and NetSuite reflects Amendment 1 only (two sales orders totalling 2.25 million with the original end date 2026-08-31 quarterly billing and Net 30). The exposure is about 480 thousand dollars between the contract and NetSuite plus a 120 thousand dollar overstatement in Salesforce plus four contract milestones that NetSuite will never bill.

Dana Whitfield (Pharma East) is the account owner with the highest mismatch rate: about 14 of her 35 agreements fail a check which is roughly twice the overall rate. The pattern is rounding the opportunity amount and leaving a line item off the opportunity.

Amended agreements fail the match far more often than unamended ones (roughly 43 percent versus 4 percent). Boomi does not always carry amendments into NetSuite and Salesforce reps do not always book the amendment opportunity; the Boomi upgrade of 2026-03-01 made amendment syncing worse (see the Boomi Sync Incident Bulletin).

Exposure (open exposure or dollar exposure) is the sum of the absolute dollar variance across open findings. An agreement contributes once per check it fails: TCV mismatches contribute the Salesforce minus contract difference amendments not in NetSuite contribute the contract minus NetSuite difference duplicate orders contribute the over-booked amount and each missing milestone contributes its scheduled amount. Checks without a dollar variance contribute zero.

Mismatch rate is the number of agreements with at least one finding divided by the number of agreements checked. Severity is the control's default severity escalated to High when the absolute dollar variance reaches the control's high severity threshold (100 thousand dollars for TCV amendments-not-in-NetSuite duplicate orders and missing milestones).

Owning teams: Sales Ops owns contract-versus-Salesforce checks (TCV mismatch product count opportunity without contract link amendment not in Salesforce); Revenue Accounting owns end date amendment-not-in-NetSuite duplicate orders and orders without an opportunity; Billing owns payment terms billing frequency and missing billing milestones.

A billing milestone is considered present in NetSuite when a bill on one of the agreement's sales orders falls within 7 days of the scheduled date for the same amount within 1 dollar; otherwise it is a missing milestone finding. Contract value is matched to Salesforce within 100 dollars.

Account owners and sales pods: Pharma East (Dana Whitfield Marcus Oyelaran Priya Natarajan) Pharma West (Elena Castellanos Tom Reinholt Aisha Bakare) Health Systems East (Jordan Feld Naomi Tsang Luis Arreola) Health Systems West (Grace Okafor Ben Halvorsen-Ruiz Sofia Marchetti).

Products: pharma brands buy Specialty Targeted Campaign Sponsored Content Clinical Newsletter Placement and Peer Discussion Program; health systems buy Recruiting Placement Employer Branding Residency Navigator Sponsorship and Physician Directory Enhanced Profile. Product names are identical across contracts Salesforce products and NetSuite items.

SOX order-to-cash controls referenced by the checks: OTC-02 completeness of contract linkage OTC-04 order entry accuracy OTC-05 sales order uniqueness OTC-07 amendment processing OTC-09 revenue schedule accuracy OTC-11 billing terms accuracy OTC-12 billing schedule completeness.

The Amendment Sync Watch agent re-runs the same checks every weekday morning on agreements signed or amended in the last 7 days and posts new findings grouped by owning team so the three teams see one list instead of three.

The signed PDFs live in the contract archive (an S3 bucket) under the file name in CONTRACTS.pdf_file_name; the extracted terms in the tables are what the reconciliation uses and the PDF is the evidence a reviewer opens to confirm a finding.
